def _notarize_impl(ctx):
    out = ctx.actions.declare_file(ctx.label.name + ".zip")
    ctx.actions.run(
        executable = ctx.executable._notarytool,
        arguments = ["submit", "--wait", ctx.file.app.path, "--output", out.path],
